title: Weak Serre closure for finite and integral certified adic coefficients
statement: Fix a prime ell, a field k in universe u with positive prime characteristic different from ell, and a separated finite-type k-scheme X. For any finite normed extension E of Q_ell, let Lambda be the condensed ring of continuous E-valued functions. Alternatively let E be a finite extension of Q_ell with a specified Q_ell-embedding in PadicAlgCl ell and let Lambda be the condensed ring of its integers with the induced topology. In either case let C be the object property of constructible Lambda_X-modules, namely finite stratifications with locally finitely presented inverse images [def-sfb-constructible-module]. The replete closure C.ind under filtered colimits indexed by small categories in universe u+1, taken in the ordinary category of internal module sheaves, is closed under kernels, cokernels, and extensions. Kernel and cokernel closure apply to arbitrary morphisms between two C.ind objects; extension closure applies to any ambient short exact sequence whose end terms are in C.ind.

proof.text: Embed each normed finite extension in the fixed algebraic closure; its algebra equivalence and inverse are continuous by finite dimensionality. The actual continuous-map coefficient isomorphism induces an exact equivalence on internal modules. Transport local finite presentations on each stratum, then transport ambient ind objects through this equivalence.

For the canonical finite subfield, local finite freeness identifies the source constructibility predicate with finite constant models. Apply the stated ind kernel/cokernel and extension theorems, and transport all three closures back along restriction of scalars.
The integral branch is precisely the separate integral weak-Serre intermediate; combine the branches.

lean.statement:
theorem ellAdic_finite_indConstructible_weakSerre :
    (∀ (E : Type) [NormedField E] [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[ℓ] E]
      [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[ℓ] E],
      let P := ObjectProperty.ind.{u + 1}
        (IsConstructibleModuleObject
          (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X.left))
      P.IsClosedUnderKernels ∧ P.IsClosedUnderCokernels ∧ P.IsClosedUnderExtensions) ∧
    (∀ (E : Type) [Field E] [Algebra E (PadicAlgCl ℓ)] [Algebra ℚ_[ℓ] E]
      [IsScalarTower ℚ_[ℓ] E (PadicAlgCl ℓ)] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[ℓ] E],
      let P := ObjectProperty.ind.{u + 1}
        (IsConstructibleModuleObject
          (condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E) X.left))
      P.IsClosedUnderKernels ∧ P.IsClosedUnderCokernels ∧ P.IsClosedUnderExtensions)
